audience.programmeDescription: VU Communication and Information Studies examines language, media and communication. The Dutch Media en Journalistiek route combines media analysis, rhetoric, journalism practice, research methods and an individual thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The published course allocation totals 180 EC, but a required course has a prerequisite that is absent from the route table. We show that allocation with the unresolved condition and withhold UCR alternatives pending clarification.

curriculum.routeLabel: Media en Journalistiek; prerequisite pathway unresolved
curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC shown is the published allocation, including 30 EC of open space. Discourse and Social Interaction requires prior Discourse Analysis, which is absent from this route table. An applicable replacement or exemption rule is needed before the pathway can be approved. The degree is not asserted to lack credits. The thesis and colloquium require all first- and second-year courses. The usual first-year threshold is 42 EC plus academic skills and the language test. Orientation modules and the language test carry no extra credit; attendance and approved choice rules apply.

componentNotes.y3-01: Open 30 EC: an approved minor, approved free choices with at least 12 EC at advanced level, or a permitted internship and courses.
componentNotes.y2-03: Its published Discourse Analysis prerequisite is not present in the adopted route allocation.
componentNotes.y3-05: A 3 EC parallel colloquium: organize a symposium, present thesis research and write a public-facing science piece. All components must pass.
componentNotes.y3-06: A 9 EC individual research thesis within a supervised theme group. Mandatory meetings, an approved work plan and a progress decision apply; supervisor and second reader assess independently.
